settings.title: Help and questions
settings.heading: Help and questions
settings.subheading: Sizes, delivery, returns and the prints. Type a word to find a question.
settings.none_label: No question matches that. Write to us instead.

settings.question: Which size should I take?
settings.answer: Tees and crews are cut a little boxy with a dropped shoulder. If you are between two sizes, take the smaller one for a closer fit. Every product page has the measurements.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: Each piece is printed when you order it and leaves within two working days, tracked. Add your own delivery times on the shipping page.

settings.question: Can I send something back?
settings.answer: Yes, within 30 days if it is unworn and unwashed. Write to us with your order number and we send a return label. See the refund policy.

settings.question: Will the print crack or fade?
settings.answer: The prints are water based ink pressed into the cotton, so they stay soft. Wash cold and inside out, hang to dry, and they last as long as the tee.

settings.question: Are the stickers waterproof?
settings.answer: Yes. They are matte vinyl, cut to shape, and fine on a water bottle or a laptop lid. They peel off cleanly too.

settings.question: Do you restock sold out pieces?
settings.answer: Most prints come back once. Sign up to the mailing list and you hear about it a day before everyone else.
